# Graphviz

This distribution includes Graphviz version `16.1.0`, obtained from
the official Graphviz distribution.

It includes the unmodified `dot` binary and the additional
Graphviz runtime files required by the binary and the application to convert DOT files
into SVG files.

Graphviz is licensed under the Eclipse Public License, Version 2.0, a copy of which is included at:

```text
third-party/graphviz/EPL-2.0.txt
```

## Corresponding source

The complete corresponding upstream Graphviz source release is included at:

```text
third-party/graphviz/graphviz-16.1.0.tar.gz
```

The SHA-256 checksum published by Graphviz for that source archive is
included at:

```text
third-party/graphviz/graphviz-16.1.0.tar.gz.sha256
```

Published SHA-256 checksum:

```text
beea483ab130f456c1c3905f4f2e40778a9c493c3d73ae8012367d552d71ca84  graphviz-16.1.0.tar.gz
```

The source archive is the complete upstream Graphviz source release.
This application does not include all compiled Graphviz tools; it
includes only the executable and runtime files listed below.

## Modifications

The Graphviz files included in this application have not been modified
by this project.

They are used by this application to convert DOT files into SVG files.
